name: a question first
say: This is Hypercomb. Before we explain anything, one question. Where does your work actually live? For most software, the honest answer is: on someone else's computer, behind someone else's login, in someone else's format. Hypercomb starts from a different premise — your work lives with you. Everything you're about to see is a real, working application: every piece of footage in this presentation was recorded live from a real hive. Nineteen scenes from now, you'll know what Hypercomb is, why it exists, and where it's going.
